# EFRAME — 企业级全栈支撑框架 (linlan-eframe)

> Java 17 + Spring Boot 3.5.16 企业级后端框架 + Vue3 管理前端，内置机构、管理员、角色、权限、分组、消息、代码生成与定时任务能力。

Key capabilities:
- 管理员 / 机构 / 角色 / 岗位 / 分组 / 消息管理
- Spring Security 权限与数据范围控制
- MyBatis + Druid 多数据源与 PageHelper 分页
- module-generator 代码生成
- module-quartz 定时任务
- Smart-doc 接口文档生成
- ai-pilot AI 开发助手模板与 workflow

Tech stack: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.5.16, Spring Framework 6.2.14, Spring Security 6.5.7, MyBatis 3.5.19, Druid, Quartz, Maven
Frontend stack: Vue 3.2, Element Plus 2.9, Ant Design Vue 3, Pinia, Vue Router 4, Vite 2.7
Version: backend 1.2.2, frontend 1.2.0
Repository: https://gitee.com/linlannet/linlan-eframe

Build / Test:
- Backend build:  `cd backend && mvn clean install`
- Backend run:    `mvn -pl eframe-web -am spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev`
- Backend jar:    `java -jar backend/eframe-web/target/eframe-web.jar --spring.profiles.active=dev`
- Backend test:   `mvn test`
- Frontend:       `cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev`
- Frontend build: `npm run build`
- Frontend has no test/lint script configured

Runtime:
- Dev:  port 8081, context `/eframe_backend/`
- Prod: port 8310, context `/eframe_backend`
- Default profile: `ver` (only dev/prod YAML present in repo)
- Frontend dev proxy: `/dev_api` → `http://localhost:8081/eframe_backend/`

Module map:
- backend/eframe-support       utilities and data support
- backend/eframe-model         model layer (service/dao)
- backend/eframe-core          core shared logic
- backend/eframe-view          view logic (read/write separation)
- backend/eframe-api           common API resources
- backend/module-generator     code generation
- backend/module-quartz        scheduled jobs
- backend/eframe-web           web app + FrameApplication
- backend/module-extend        extension module
- backend/scripts              bin / codestyle / docker / sql
- frontend/src                 api / views / components / directive / utils
- docs/api-docs                Smart-doc generated API docs
- ai-pilot                     AI pilot templates and workflows
